evd_title: GPT-4 made errors in 6 of 10 abstract comparison pairs favoring the inferior abstract
finding: GPT-4 made errors in 6 of 10 abstract comparison pairs favoring the inferior abstract
I: GPT-4 via ChatGPT (May 3/12 2023 builds), zero-shot pairwise selection, 3 responses per pair
C: Superior abstract by construction (author-designed ground truth)
O: Overall 4 of 10 correct (40% accuracy); failures incl. positive-result bias, prompt injection, bombastic language
T: GPT-4 ChatGPT builds May 3 and May 12 2023; paper 2023
